title: NormalizedExtraction
description: The shape every extraction adapter must return, whatever the upstream service actually sent. Enforced at runtime by lib/domain/schemas.ts (normalizedExtractionSchema). A response that cannot be reduced to this shape is an extraction failure, never partial data passed downstream as if it were trustworthy.

namedInsured.description: Named insured as printed on the document. Required for a Validated result.

policyNumber.description: Carrier policy number, as printed. Not normalized — formats are carrier-specific and reformatting would destroy information. Required for a Validated result.

carrier.description: Issuing carrier. Required for a Validated result.

effectiveDate.description: Policy inception, normalized to ISO 8601 calendar date.

expirationDate.description: Policy expiration, normalized to ISO 8601 calendar date.

policyType.description: Policy type read from the document. Constrained to the option set. Never used to route — a value contradicting the submitted line of business is recorded as a review reason (FR-030). 'Unknown' when nothing recognizable was found.

coverageAmount.description: Principal limit, in the document's currency, as a plain number. Currency symbols and thousands separators are stripped during normalization.

fieldConfidence.description: Per-field confidence, keyed by the field names above. Retained so a reviewer can see which specific field was weak rather than only that the aggregate was low (BR-018). Fields the service returned without a confidence are omitted.

extractionConfidence.description: Aggregate confidence: the arithmetic mean of the per-field confidences. Compared against EXTRACTION_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD (default 0.80, inclusive) to decide whether the result is Validated or Unverified (BR-007, BR-019).
